{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders (revenue == '999999.99')
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Parse revenue as float after removing commas
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed ones count)
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate and revenue by channel, stratified by customer_segment
# We will compute weighted averages by segment size to adjust for confounding

# Group by channel and segment
stratified = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])

# Compute conversion rate and average revenue per group
conversion_by_group = stratified['converted'].mean()
revenue_by_group = stratified['revenue'].mean()

# Get total count per channel
channel_counts = df_final['channel'].value_counts()

# Compute weighted average conversion rate by channel (weighted by segment size)
weighted_conv = []
for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    group_data = df_final[df_final['channel'] == channel]
    segment_counts = group_data['customer_segment'].value_counts()
    total = segment_counts.sum()
    weighted_avg = (segment_counts * conversion_by_group[channel]).sum() / total
    weighted_conv.append(weighted_avg)

weighted_conv = pd.Series(weighted_conv, index=['email', 'paid_search'])

# Compute weighted average revenue by channel
weighted_rev = []
for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    group_data = df_final[df_final['channel'] == channel]
    segment_counts = group_data['customer_segment'].value_counts()
    total = segment_counts.sum()
    weighted_avg = (segment_counts * revenue_by_group[channel]).sum() / total
    weighted_rev.append(weighted_avg)

weighted_rev = pd.Series(weighted_rev, index=['email', 'paid_search'])

# Compute differences
conv_diff = weighted_conv['email'] - weighted_conv['paid_search']
rev_diff = weighted_rev['email'] - weighted_rev['paid_search']

# Print final results
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_conv['email']:.3f}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_conv['paid_search']:.3f}")
print(f"Weighted average revenue (email): ${weighted_rev['email']:,.2f}")
print(f"Weighted average revenue (paid_search): ${weighted_rev['paid_search']:,.2f}")
print(f"Difference in weighted conversion rate: {conv_diff:.3f}")
print(f"Difference in weighted average revenue: ${rev_diff:,.2f}")"}
